latest.title: Klein bottle and optimal systolic inequality for nonpositively curved surfaces
latest.abstract: We show that the systolic area of every nonpositively curved closed surface $M$ other than the torus is at least $1$, with equality if and only if $M$ is isometric to a square flat Klein bottle. The proof focuses on the Klein-double $4\mathbb RP^2$ and exploits Weil's isoperimetric inequality and a comparison theorem involving a new kind of exponential-type map.
latest.workSummary: 证明除环面外非正曲率闭曲面的 systolic area 至少为 1，等号仅为正方形平坦 Klein 瓶。
latest.breakthrough: 给出跨拓扑类型的锐利收缩长度–面积界及等号刻画。
latest.limitations: 需保留非正曲率与环面例外。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
latest.priorityReason: 比较几何与收缩不等式核心方向，优先阅读。
